spec_match.rationale: Calls getContext('2d', {colorSpace, colorType, toneMapping}) on HTMLCanvasElement or OffscreenCanvas and compares the request with getContextAttributes(). Only an echo of 'extended' counts as support.

interactive.rationale: Host, colorSpace, colorType and toneMapping selects, a create button, a second-getContext edge button and a 14-combination matrix all make real calls.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises request vs echo, the ignored-member trap, the future-mode TypeError and the second-getContext edge case. All four are delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the ignored member, an invalid future mode (TypeError with experimental features, silent without, observed and documented), colour spaces gated by their own flags (TypeError), unorm8+extended, and second-getContext immutability.

conformance.rationale: Backs extended-mode-echoed, default-mode-standard, explicit-standard-echoed, unknown-mode-rejected, offscreen-extended-echoed and mode-fixed-at-creation.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 headless (Playwright), default and with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: every button, select and range exercised, console/pageerror/failed-request clean, 0px overflow. Observed 'ignored' for every extended request, TypeError for rec2100-*/linear without flags, and the TypeError vs silent split for 'reinhard'. The honoured branch has not run, because 153 lacks the implementation.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the load-time probe state and each inspector call (fails only when the toneMapping member is absent), and the matrix run.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; buttons set both background and color; the state verdict is shown with a border colour plus text.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled selects, a role=status verdict, scrollable table regions with aria-labels, and visible focus outlines.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: At 360x740 the four selects stack to one column and the tables scroll inside their wrapper. 0px page overflow at both sizes.

openQuestions.title: Verify the extended success path and the HDR visual on a build with CanvasToneMapping
openQuestions.detail: Chrome 153, the only build available here, reports toneMapping.mode 'standard' even with --enable-blink-features=CanvasToneMapping, so the honoured branch has not run. Re-verify on Chrome 160+/Canary with the flag, ideally on an HDR display: confirm the echo reads 'extended' and that the bottom ramp, sun and highlights exceed SDR white.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Controls should be at least 44x44 CSS px on touch screens, and components should adapt to their container so nothing overflows.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All buttons, selects, inputs and ranges have min-height 44px. Selects inside .field are width:100% after a measured 117px overflow at 360px caused by long option text. Every page was re-measured at 0px overflow at 360x740 and 1280x800.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: drive.js runs: overflow=0 on every page/viewport; responsive-check desktop ok 1/1, mobile ok 1/1

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native controls with labels. Announce discrete outcomes through polite status/log regions and keep rapidly changing values out of live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every control is a native button/select/input with a visible label. Outcomes go to role=status / role=log regions. High-frequency readouts (slider positions, meters) use aria-live=off and announce only on change of state.

guidanceConsulted.query: canvas HDR wide gamut color rendering
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: The guide covers the html-in-canvas origin trial and is gated behind an explicit opt-in.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Exception: no origin-trial opt-in was made (npx modern-web-guidance@latest set-allow-origin-trials not run). Canvas content is exposed with role=img plus aria-label and a text status/readback table carrying the same information.

summary: An inspection tool for the exact settings dictionary. It treats only an echoed 'extended' as support and surfaces each false-support trap that Chrome 153 shows.
